stem: During the Renaissance, history was thought to be ____: it supplied instances of good and bad behavior in the past, thus informing the ethical precepts of the present.
The report is admittedly (i)____ : it is intended to suggest new lines of research rather than to deal with the subject in a (ii)____ manner.

Memoirs are inherently (i)____, but Larry McMurtry’s volume of reminiscences about his life with books—not as a novelist but as a reader and bookstore owner—is especially (ii)____: nearly every page sounds a note of farewell to an age of books that he sees as passing.

Persian prose writers from the second half of the twelfth century onward were characteristically (i)____ the literary form of their works, a fact that some scholars have perceived as a derogation of those works’ content. It may be better interpreted as (ii)____ the development of an awareness of authorship, for the awareness of authorship (iii)____ the awareness of form.
Scientists are investigating odors so faint that people cannot ____ them in order to see whether such odors can nevertheless change the way people interact.

The tribes’ ____ a settled mode of living was derived from their long-standing traditions, which, though differing from one tribal group to another, always included a resistance to nomadic lifestyles.
In politics, tactical calculations about which groups a candidate should appeal to are never pleasant, but they are not always ____, and sometimes they are necessary.
